theme.title: Clocks, rules and oddities
theme.subtitle: Before and after the shot clock
theme.recap: The shot clock arrived in 1954 after games like a 19–18 final and a six-overtime game with one shot per overtime.

questions.prompt: How many seconds does an NBA team have to shoot under the shot clock?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The NBA has had a 24-second limit since 1954.

questions.prompt: Before the shot clock, the Fort Wayne Pistons beat the Lakers in 1950 with how many points?
questions.context: Fort Wayne Pistons vs Minneapolis Lakers · November 22, 1950

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Minneapolis Lakers by a record-low score of 19–18, including 3–1 in the fourth quarter.

questions.prompt: After an offensive rebound, what is the NBA shot clock reset to?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The shot clock is instead set to 14 following an offensive rebound.

questions.prompt: Before the shot clock, two teams played a game with only one shot in each overtime. How many overtimes?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: played a six-overtime game with only one shot in each overtime

questions.prompt: On November 1, 2021, Atlanta and Washington combined to make how many free throws without a single miss?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 45 between Atlanta Hawks (29-for-29) and Washington Wizards (16-for-16) on November 1, 2021
